Noise-C, rweather/noise-c @ cfe25410979a87391bb9ac8d4d4bef64e9f268c6.
Only Noise_IK_25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256 is enabled by this port.
Upstream source is retained with its licenses. The Curve25519 backend uses
its existing Donna implementation for basepoint multiplication as well.
Zephyr randomness and unavailable factory stubs live outside the vendor tree.
Whitespace is normalized; unused algorithms, key-container helpers and build files are not used.
